title: Maintenance survey
description: One read-only survey pass over one area of the codebase (plans/full-pipeline.md, the 7th day). New findings join the persistent cleanup list; confirmations re-check the list's items in this pass's area.

findings.description: Cleanup worth doing that is not already on the list (or is on it only as closed and came back).

category.description: test-pins-internals: an existing test imports or asserts an internal name, so the fix needs the owner (tests are append-only).

files.description: Repo paths the cleanup changes (src/**, tests/**, CLAUDE.md), most important first.

claim.description: What is wrong, in one or two sentences.

evidence.description: Code quoted with file:line, the copies side by side, or the measured numbers.

suggestedFix.description: The smallest behaviour-preserving change, reusing what exists.

confirmations.description: For every open or stale item of your area on the cleanup list: is the problem still in the code?
